source_refs.note: Applications: a main subheading of 28.3 Thin-Layer Chromatography, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 179-179.

items: TLC identify unknown compounds by comparing their Rf values with standard known values.
The purity of a substance can be checked by TLC.
The progress of reaction whether reactants are consumed or products are made, can be checked by TLC.
In pharmaceutical and food industry, purity of drugs and presence of preservatives, colourants, sweeteners in food can be checked by TLC.
TCL can also detect pollutants, pesticides, toxic substances in soil, water, food and air.
TLC is useful in forensic science where it is used to identify drugs, post blast debris, blood, sweat, semen at crime scene.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Application (v) prints 'TCL'. The technique is thin layer chromatography, TLC.
